step1_analysis.circuit_type: Equalizer / Amplifier stage with ISI monitoring
step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier stage with an asymmetric cross-coupled structure, likely used for equalization and intersymbol interference (ISI) monitoring in a high-speed receiver.

paper_reference.title: A 5–6.4-Gb/s 12-Channel Transceiver With Pre-Emphasis and Equalization

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the equalizer stage

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * R_load = 3.1 mA/V * 1 kOhm = 3.1 V/V = 9.8 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on tail current of ~0.6mA and 1kOhm load resistors.
Bandwidth is determined by the load resistor and parasitic capacitances at the output nodes.

power.description: Power consumption from the main supply

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power for a single stage is a fraction of the total receiver power.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated delay through a single differential pair stage
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical gate delay for a CML-like stage in 130nm is around 20-30ps.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, bandwidth, power, and transient characteristics of the equalizer stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Equalizer Stage Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM1 N4 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N2 N5 N5 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 N1 N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N2 N3 N3 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND LABEL_NET_0 N5 N5 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 N3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 LABEL_NET_1 N2 N5 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Vbias1 N6 0 0.9
Vbias2 N8 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

R1 VDD N7 1k
R2 VDD N0 1k

V_N1 N1 0 DC 1.2 AC 0.5 PULSE(1.1 1.3 0 20p 20p 136.25p 312.5p)
V_N2 N2 0 DC 1.2 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.3 1.1 0 20p 20p 136.25p 312.5p)

E_diff out_diff 0 N0 N7 1.0

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(N7) v(N0) v(N4) v(N3)

  ac dec 100 1M 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1M
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain-3' fall=1

  tran 1p 2n
  meas tran v_max max v(out_diff)
  meas tran v_min min v(out_diff)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(out_diff) val=-0.15 rise=1 targ v(out_diff) val=0.15 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(out_diff) val=0.15 fall=1 targ v(out_diff) val=-0.15 fall=1
  meas tran delay trig v(N1) val=1.2 rise=2 targ v(out_diff) val=0 rise=2
.endc
.end
